entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
The latest 1News Verian poll has Labour down 5 points on 32 percent, and National down 1 point to 29 percent | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1
 
The results point to the major parties' lowest level of support since the first MMP election in 1996 and its lowest under leader Christopher Luxon in the Verian poll.
 
Speaking to media on Wednesday, Prime Minister Christopher Luxon was not concerned by the poll result, saying there were lots of polls.
 
He said National had a lot of work to do to ensure New Zealanders understood the party's long-term plan. "National has a long-term plan for the economy. It's about growing the economy, it's making sure life is more affordable for people. That's the job between now and the election," Luxon said.
 
Full story: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/politics/618673/labour-national-downplay-tepid-results-in-1news-verian-poll
